These are aggregated YouTube Analytics results, not individual viewer records.

Detail tabs show up to 25 rows for each supported traffic type or embedded playback source.
Publication date and duration come from the YouTube Data API and are not limited to the reporting period.
AI-prefixed worksheets preserve time plus analytic dimensions so arbitrary date-window comparisons can be recomputed from raw counts instead of inferred from whole-period aggregates.
For combined ranges, sum additive metrics first. Recompute average view duration as estimatedMinutesWatched*60/views rather than averaging row-level averageViewDuration values.
